stem: ____ the new regulations were widely criticised, the government refused to amend them.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Even though. Tuzak: Boşluktan sonra tam cümle var. Despite / In spite of isim ister; However / Nevertheless ise cümleler arası zarftır, cümle başında bağlaç görevi görmez.

stem: The hotel was expensive. The service, ____, was poor.
explanation: Doğru cevap: though. Tuzak: Though cümle ortasında / sonunda virgülle zarf olarak 'ama, yine de' anlamı taşır; although ve even though bu konumda kullanılmaz.

stem: ____ the fact that the experiment had failed twice, the team decided to repeat it.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Despite. Tuzak: 'Despite the fact that + tam cümle' kalıbı vardır. Although / Even though 'the fact that' ile birlikte kullanılmaz.

stem: ____ having studied for months, he failed the exam.
explanation: Doğru cevap: In spite of. Tuzak: Sonrasında V-ing var. Edat olan In spite of / Despite V-ing alır; Although / Even though tam cümle ister.

stem: The first group of students performed well, ____ the second group did poorly.
explanation: Doğru cevap: whereas. Tuzak: Whereas tam cümle alır. During, despite, owing to ve instead of isim ister.

stem: Sales of electric cars rose sharply last year; ____, sales of petrol cars fell.
explanation: Doğru cevap: on the other hand. Tuzak: Noktalı virgülden sonra bağlaç (whereas, while, although) gelmez; cümleler arası zarf (on the other hand) gerekir.

stem: The weather was terrible. ____, the match went ahead as planned.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Nevertheless. Tuzak: Önceki cümle noktayla bitiyor; yeni cümleyi başlatan zıtlık zarfı gerekir. Although tek başına cümle başlatamaz, Despite / In spite of isim ister.

stem: She was exhausted, ____ she kept working until midnight.
explanation: Doğru cevap: yet. Tuzak: Virgülle iki cümleyi bağlamak için bağlaç gerekir. However / Nevertheless zarftır, therefore sonuç bildirir; yet eş değerli bağlaçtır.

stem: Some experts predict inflation will fall; ____, others warn it will rise further.
explanation: Doğru cevap: on the other hand. Tuzak: İki zıt görüş karşılaştırılıyor. Furthermore ve similarly aynı yönde bilgi ekler.

stem: On the one hand, remote work saves commuting time; on the ____ hand, it can lead to isolation.
explanation: Doğru cevap: other. Tuzak: 'On the one hand ... on the other hand' ikilisi sabit bir kalıptır.

stem: ____ the climate in Spain, the climate in England is cool and wet.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Unlike. Tuzak: Unlike isim alır. Whereas / Although tam cümle ister, However cümleler arası zarftır, Despite zıtlık değil taviz bildirir.

stem: The new policy, ____ the previous one, focuses on prevention.
explanation: Doğru cevap: in contrast to. Tuzak: In contrast to + isim; 'in contrast' ise tek başına cümle başında / arasında zarf olarak kullanılır.

stem: ____ the road was icy, many drivers decided to stay at home.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Since. Tuzak: Sonrasında tam cümle var. Because of / Owing to isim ister; Despite / In spite of zıtlık bildirir.

stem: The match was postponed ____ the heavy rain.
explanation: Doğru cevap: because of. Tuzak: Sonrasında isim grubu var: because of. Because / since / as tam cümle ister.

stem: The company went bankrupt ____ it failed to adapt to changing markets.
explanation: Doğru cevap: because. Tuzak: Sonrasında tam cümle (it failed ...) var; due to / owing to / because of isim ister.

stem: ____ the generous scholarship, she was able to continue her studies abroad.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Thanks to. Tuzak: Olumlu bir sonucun nedeni isimle verilmiş: Thanks to. Although / Whereas / Unless tam cümle ister.

stem: ____ you have already paid for the ticket, you may as well use it.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Now that. Tuzak: Gerçekleşmiş durumdan sonuç çıkarılıyor: Now that ('madem ki'). Unless ve Even if varsayım bildirir.

stem: ____ the limited budget, the committee had to cut several projects.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Given. Tuzak: Sonrasında isim grubu var: Given. Now that / Seeing that / Provided that tam cümle ister.

stem: The treatment is expensive; ____ few patients can afford it.
explanation: Doğru cevap: therefore. Tuzak: Noktalı virgülden sonra sonuç bildiren zarf gerekir. Because / although bağlaçtır; despite isim ister.

stem: He had not prepared well for the interview. ____, he did not get the job.
explanation: Doğru cevap: As a result. Tuzak: 'As a result' cümleler arası zarftır. 'As a result of' isim ister; because / due to / since neden bildirir, sonuç değil.

stem: The results were ____ surprising that the team repeated the experiment.
explanation: Doğru cevap: so. Tuzak: Sıfat (surprising) tek başına ve that ile sonuç cümlesi var: so ... that.

stem: There were ____ many applicants that the company had to extend the deadline.
explanation: Doğru cevap: so. Tuzak: so many / so much + isim + that. Such doğrudan many ile kullanılmaz.

stem: It was ____ cold day that all the schools were closed.
explanation: Doğru cevap: such a. Tuzak: Tekil sayılabilir isim (day) önünde such a gerekir; 'so a' kalıbı yoktur.

stem: They are ____ talented players that every club wants to sign them.
explanation: Doğru cevap: such. Tuzak: Çoğul isimde such kullanılır, a gelmez.

stem: She spoke slowly ____ everyone could understand her.
explanation: Doğru cevap: so that. Tuzak: Yeni özne (everyone) ve modal (could) var: so that. In order to özne değişmediğinde yalın fiille kullanılır.

stem: He told her the truth ____ she would not worry.
explanation: Doğru cevap: so that. Tuzak: Hem özne (she) hem de modal (would) var: so that. Olumsuz amaç cümlesi 'so that ... not' ile de kurulabilir; lest ise 'she' için should / V1 ister.

stem: ____ avoid delays, passengers are advised to arrive two hours early.
explanation: Doğru cevap: In order to. Tuzak: Sonrasında yalın fiil (avoid) var: In order to. So that / In order that yeni özne ister.

stem: This device is used ____ measuring air pressure.
explanation: Doğru cevap: for. Tuzak: Aracın işlevi 'for + V-ing' ile anlatılır; in order to / so as to V-ing almaz.

stem: He spoke quietly lest he ____ the baby.
explanation: Doğru cevap: wake. Tuzak: Lest sonrasında yalın fiil (veya should + V1) gelir; zaman uyumu aranmaz.

stem: They locked the gates ____ intruders should enter.
explanation: Doğru cevap: lest. Tuzak: Olumsuz amaç + should: lest. So that ile 'should enter' olumsuz anlam vermez.

stem: We should save some money ____ an emergency.
explanation: Doğru cevap: in case of. Tuzak: Sonrasında isim grubu var: in case of. In case tam cümle ister.

stem: She wrote down the address ____ she should forget it.
explanation: Doğru cevap: in case. Tuzak: Sonrasında tam cümle var ve önlem anlamı isteniyor: in case. In case of isim ister.

stem: You can borrow my car ____ you return it by six.
explanation: Doğru cevap: provided that. Tuzak: 'Şartıyla' anlamı: provided that. Unless ve even if anlamı bozar.

stem: ____ you finish your homework will you be allowed to play.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Only if. Tuzak: Cümle başında 'Only if' devrik yapı (will you ...) gerektirir.

stem: The company will not survive ____ it cuts costs.
explanation: Doğru cevap: unless. Tuzak: 'Maliyetleri kesmedikçe' anlamı: unless + olumlu fiil. 'If not' ile birlikte fiil de olumsuz olurdu.

stem: We will go for a picnic ____ it rains.
explanation: Doğru cevap: unless. Tuzak: 'Yağmur yağmadıkça' anlamı: unless. If / provided that / as long as anlamı tersine çevirir.

stem: ____ he apologised sincerely, she refused to forgive him.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Even though. Tuzak: Geçmişte gerçekleşmiş bir durum var: even though. Even if olasılık bildirir.

stem: ____ it rains tomorrow, we will still go hiking.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Even if. Tuzak: Henüz gerçekleşmemiş bir olasılık var: even if. Even though gerçekleşmiş durum için kullanılır.

stem: ____ I known about the problem, I would have helped.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Had. Tuzak: Ana cümlede would have helped (3. tip). If'siz devrik yapı: Had + özne + V3.

stem: ____ you need any help, please do not hesitate to contact us.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Should. Tuzak: Gelecek / olasılık anlamlı 1. tip koşulda devrik yapı: Should + özne + V1.

stem: ____ your advice, I would have made a terrible mistake.
explanation: Doğru cevap: But for. Tuzak: Sonrasında isim var ve 'olmasaydı' anlamı isteniyor: But for. Unless / Although / Because / While tam cümle ister.

stem: Had it not been ____ her support, the project would have failed.
explanation: Doğru cevap: for. Tuzak: Kalıp: Had it not been for + isim.

stem: Please keep the receipt; ____ we cannot refund your money.
explanation: Doğru cevap: otherwise. Tuzak: Önceki cümlede istenen yapılmazsa olacak sonuç: otherwise.

stem: We must act quickly ____ we will lose the opportunity.
explanation: Doğru cevap: or else. Tuzak: 'Yoksa' anlamı: or else. But zıtlık, so that amaç bildirir.

stem: The hotel is cheap and clean; ____, it is close to the beach.
explanation: Doğru cevap: moreover. Tuzak: Aynı yönde ek bir olumlu bilgi var: moreover. However / nevertheless zıtlık bildirir.

stem: The plan is practical. ____, it is cheaper than the alternatives.
explanation: Doğru cevap: In addition. Tuzak: Cümle arası ekleme zarfı: In addition. 'In addition to' isim ister; 'besides of' diye kalıp yoktur.

stem: ____ being intelligent, she is also very hardworking.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Besides. Tuzak: Sonrasında V-ing var ve anlam 'ek olarak': Besides. Despite / In spite of zıtlık, instead of tercih bildirir.

stem: ____ the fee, you must pay a deposit.
explanation: Doğru cevap: In addition to. Tuzak: Sonrasında isim grubu var: In addition to. Moreover / Furthermore cümleler arası zarftır.

stem: Not only ____ the exam, but he also won the top prize.
explanation: Doğru cevap: did he pass. Tuzak: Not only cümle başındayken devrik yapı gerekir: Not only did he pass ...

stem: She is not only intelligent but also ____.
explanation: Doğru cevap: hardworking. Tuzak: Paralellik: sıfat (intelligent) ile sıfat (hardworking) eşleşir.

stem: Both the teachers ____ the students were excited about the trip.
explanation: Doğru cevap: and. Tuzak: Both yalnızca and ile eşleşir.

stem: The new phone is both fast ____ reliable.
explanation: Doğru cevap: and. Tuzak: Both ... and; both ... or / both ... but yoktur.

stem: Neither Tom nor his parents ____ the news yet.
explanation: Doğru cevap: have heard. Tuzak: Neither ... nor yapısında fiil, nor'a yakın özneye uyar: his parents → have heard.

stem: He could not find the keys, and ____ could he find his wallet.
explanation: Doğru cevap: neither. Tuzak: Olumsuz cümleden sonra devrik 'neither could he' kullanılır; either / so / too / also bu yapıyı kuramaz.

stem: She was reading a book ____ the lights went out.
explanation: Doğru cevap: when. Tuzak: Past continuous eylem ve onu kesen kısa olay: 'when the lights went out'. While + kısa olay kullanılmaz; during isim ister.

stem: ____ the lecture, several students fell asleep.
explanation: Doğru cevap: During. Tuzak: Sonrasında isim grubu (the lecture) var: During. While / When / As tam cümle ister.

stem: I will call you as soon as I ____ home.
explanation: Doğru cevap: get. Tuzak: Zaman bağlacından sonra gelecek için present simple kullanılır.

stem: ____ the sun rose, the birds began to sing.
explanation: Doğru cevap: The moment. Tuzak: Sonrasında tam cümle ve 'ir -mez' anlamı: The moment. During / Throughout / Despite / Prior to isim ister.

stem: Don't open the box ____ I tell you to.
explanation: Doğru cevap: until. Tuzak: Eylemin o ana kadar sürmemesi gerektiği anlatılıyor: until. By tek seferlik bitiş anlatır.

stem: I will finish the report ____ Friday.
explanation: Doğru cevap: by. Tuzak: Bitiş zamanı (en geç Cuma) için by kullanılır; until sürekliliği anlatır.

stem: By the time we arrived, the film ____.
explanation: Doğru cevap: had started. Tuzak: By the time + past simple → ana cümlede past perfect.

stem: By the time she retires, she ____ here for forty years.
explanation: Doğru cevap: will have worked. Tuzak: By the time + present simple → ana cümlede future perfect.

stem: ____ I visit my grandmother, she bakes a cake.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Whenever. Tuzak: Zaman anlamı ve tekrar eden durum: Whenever.

stem: Call me ____ you need help.
explanation: Doğru cevap: whenever. Tuzak: Zaman anlamlı genelleme: whenever.

stem: I ____ him since 2015.
explanation: Doğru cevap: haven't seen. Tuzak: Since ile present perfect kullanılır.

stem: It has been five years ____ we last met.
explanation: Doğru cevap: since. Tuzak: 'It has been + süre + since + past simple' kalıbı.

stem: Hardly had he sat down ____ the phone rang.
explanation: Doğru cevap: when. Tuzak: Hardly ... WHEN; No sooner ... THAN.

stem: No sooner had the film started ____ the power went out.
explanation: Doğru cevap: than. Tuzak: No sooner ... THAN; Hardly ... WHEN.

stem: ____ signing the contract, read it carefully.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Prior to. Tuzak: Sonrasında V-ing var: Prior to + V-ing.

stem: She had worked as a nurse ____ she became a doctor.
explanation: Doğru cevap: before. Tuzak: Sonrasında tam cümle var: before. Prior to / ahead of isim ister.

stem: ____ the speech, there was a long applause.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Following. Tuzak: Sonrasında isim var: Following. Next / later / then / afterwards zarftır.

stem: ____ completing the course, students receive a certificate.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Upon. Tuzak: Upon + V-ing kalıbı.

stem: He fell asleep ____ the film.
explanation: Doğru cevap: during. Tuzak: Sonrasında isim (the film) var: during. While / when tam cümle ister.

stem: She worked abroad ____ three years.
explanation: Doğru cevap: for. Tuzak: Süre miktarı için for kullanılır.

stem: Why don't you walk ____ taking the bus?
explanation: Doğru cevap: instead of. Tuzak: Sonrasında V-ing var: instead of. Instead tek başına zarftır.

stem: I would rather stay home ____ go out in this weather.
explanation: Doğru cevap: than. Tuzak: Would rather + V1 + than + V1.

stem: Everyone ____ Mark attended the meeting.
explanation: Doğru cevap: except. Tuzak: 'Mark hariç' anlamı: except.

stem: The shop is open every day ____ Sundays.
explanation: Doğru cevap: except. Tuzak: 'Pazar günleri hariç' anlamı: except.

stem: ____ happens, I will support you.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Whatever. Tuzak: 'Ne olursa olsun' anlamı: whatever.

stem: ____ hard she tries, she cannot win.
explanation: Doğru cevap: However. Tuzak: However + sıfat / zarf + özne + fiil.

stem: I wonder ____ she will accept the offer.
explanation: Doğru cevap: whether. Tuzak: Dolaylı soru: whether.

stem: The decision depends on ____ the funding is approved.
explanation: Doğru cevap: whether. Tuzak: Edattan sonra if değil whether kullanılır.

stem: He behaves as if he ____ the boss, but he is just an intern.
explanation: Doğru cevap: were. Tuzak: Gerçek dışı durumda as if + were.

stem: It looks ____ it is going to rain.
explanation: Doğru cevap: as if. Tuzak: Benzetme: as if + cümle.

stem: ____ me, this plan is too risky.
explanation: Doğru cevap: In my opinion. Tuzak: According to kişinin kendi görüşünde kullanılmaz; In my opinion denir.

stem: The work was done ____ the instructions.
explanation: Doğru cevap: in accordance with. Tuzak: Kurala uygunluk: in accordance with.

stem: ____ your question, I will reply tomorrow.
explanation: Doğru cevap: With regard to. Tuzak: Konuyu belirtir: With regard to.

stem: I am writing with ____ to your recent application.
explanation: Doğru cevap: regard. Tuzak: Kalıp: with regard to (regard tekil).

stem: The first speaker supported the plan; ____, the second one expressed her approval.
explanation: Doğru cevap: similarly. Tuzak: İki cümle aynı yönde: similarly.

stem: He enjoys cooking. ____, his wife loves baking.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Likewise. Tuzak: Benzer durum: likewise.

stem: Many animals, ____ elephants and whales, are endangered.
explanation: Doğru cevap: such as. Tuzak: İsim grubu listesi için such as kullanılır.

stem: Some fruits are rich in vitamin C. ____, oranges and kiwis.
explanation: Doğru cevap: For example. Tuzak: Örnek veren cümle arası ifade: For example.

stem: He is a vegetarian; ____, he doesn't eat meat.
explanation: Doğru cevap: in other words. Tuzak: İkinci cümle birincinin yeniden ifadesi: in other words.

stem: The company has gone bankrupt; ____, it can no longer pay its debts.
explanation: Doğru cevap: in other words. Tuzak: İkinci cümle birinciyi açıklıyor: in other words.

stem: ____, we can say that the project was a success.
explanation: Doğru cevap: In conclusion. Tuzak: Genel sonuç: In conclusion.

stem: He was late, he forgot his notes, and he was nervous. ____, the presentation was a disaster.
explanation: Doğru cevap: All in all. Tuzak: Özetleyen sonuç: All in all.

stem: People think he is rich. ____, he has huge debts.
explanation: Doğru cevap: In fact. Tuzak: Yanlış varsayımı düzeltir: In fact.

stem: The task was not difficult; ____, it was surprisingly easy.
explanation: Doğru cevap: in fact. Tuzak: Önceki ifadeyi güçlendirir: in fact.

stem: Ann was cooking dinner. ____, Tom was setting the table.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Meanwhile. Tuzak: Aynı anda gerçekleşen olay: Meanwhile.

stem: The results will be announced next week. ____, please be patient.
explanation: Doğru cevap: In the meantime. Tuzak: Beklenen süre boyunca: In the meantime.

stem: We had dinner, and ____ we went for a walk.
explanation: Doğru cevap: afterwards. Tuzak: Zarf olarak 'sonrasında' anlamı: afterwards.

stem: The patient was given medicine; ____, his fever dropped.
explanation: Doğru cevap: subsequently. Tuzak: Kronolojik sıra: subsequently.

stem: It was raining heavily, ____ we stayed at home.
explanation: Doğru cevap: so. Tuzak: Virgülden sonra sonuç bildiren bağlaç: so.

stem: He studied hard, ____ he passed the exam.
explanation: Doğru cevap: so. Tuzak: Sonuç bildirir: so. But / although zıtlık bildirir.

stem: ____ the strike, all flights were cancelled.
explanation: Doğru cevap: As a result of. Tuzak: Sonrasında isim var: As a result of.

stem: The factory closed down. ____, hundreds of people lost their jobs.
explanation: Doğru cevap: As a result. Tuzak: Cümleler arası zarf: As a result.

stem: They crossed the river ____ a rope bridge.
explanation: Doğru cevap: by means of. Tuzak: Araç belirten isim grubu: by means of.

stem: The message was transmitted ____ a satellite.
explanation: Doğru cevap: by means of. Tuzak: Araç / vasıta: by means of.

stem: He tried hard, ____ he failed.
explanation: Doğru cevap: but. Tuzak: Virgülden sonra zıtlık: but. Although ile ikinci yarı bağlanamaz.

stem: ____ she was tired, she kept working.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Although. Tuzak: Cümle başında yan cümle başlatan bağlaç: Although. But / yet / however cümleyi başlatamaz.

stem: Everyone is welcome, ____ age or background.
explanation: Doğru cevap: regardless of. Tuzak: Sonrasında isim var: regardless of.

stem: The law applies to all citizens ____ they are rich or poor.
explanation: Doğru cevap: regardless of whether. Tuzak: Sonrasında whether cümlesi var: regardless of whether.

stem: She is as tall ____ her brother.
explanation: Doğru cevap: as. Tuzak: Eşitlik kalıbı: as ... as.

stem: There aren't ____ students in this class as in the other one.
explanation: Doğru cevap: as many. Tuzak: Sayılabilir isim (students): as many ... as.

stem: Just as the sun rises in the east, ____ it sets in the west.
explanation: Doğru cevap: so. Tuzak: Just as ... so kalıbı.

stem: He treated her ____ he would treat his own sister.
explanation: Doğru cevap: just as. Tuzak: Benzetme: just as + cümle.

stem: If it ____ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
explanation: Doğru cevap: rains. Tuzak: If cümlesinde will / would kullanılmaz; ana cümlede will var: present simple.

stem: If I ____ you, I would accept the offer.
explanation: Doğru cevap: were. Tuzak: 2. tip koşul: If + were, would + V1.

stem: ____ the news, she burst into tears.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Upon hearing. Tuzak: Upon + V-ing.

stem: ____ arrival, the guests were shown to their rooms.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Upon. Tuzak: Upon arrival kalıbı.

stem: The two cities are similar ____ size but different in climate.
explanation: Doğru cevap: in terms of. Tuzak: Açısından: in terms of.

stem: ____ salary, the job is excellent.
explanation: Doğru cevap: In terms of. Tuzak: Sonrasında isim var ve 'açısından': In terms of.

stem: The manager, along with his assistants, ____ attending the conference.
explanation: Doğru cevap: is. Tuzak: Along with araya girse de özne tekildir (the manager).

stem: Mary, together with her sisters, ____ visiting us tomorrow.
explanation: Doğru cevap: is. Tuzak: Together with araya girse de özne tekildir (Mary).

stem: You can improve your English ____ a lot.
explanation: Doğru cevap: by reading. Tuzak: By + V-ing: yöntem.

stem: He saved money ____ walking to work instead of driving.
explanation: Doğru cevap: by. Tuzak: Yöntem: by + V-ing.

stem: I didn't go to the party. ____, I stayed home and read.
explanation: Doğru cevap: Instead. Tuzak: Cümle başında tek başına: Instead.

stem: Don't waste money on sweets. Buy fruit ____.
explanation: Doğru cevap: instead. Tuzak: Cümle sonunda tek başına: instead.
